game_concept: A strategy race set in Mystic Forest – Herbalist Hut, a herbalist's hut: the beast tamer must handle giant beetles while practicing control flow: for loops. Core idea – Stride Selector: Use range(start, stop, step) to hit only the right stepping stones.
theme: Mystic Forest – Herbalist Hut: a herbalist's hut
core_gameplay_loop: In Herbalist Hut, repeat each round: Use range(start, stop, step) to hit only the right stepping stones. Each round the rival advances, and solving the step moves the beast tamer ahead. Then check the stones value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the root gate by solving code steps involving stones that move the beast tamer forward.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.7).
lose_condition: The rival reaches the root gate first, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 5 – Control Flow: For Loops | Level 2 (intro tier): Stride Selector
assets_style: lush pixel-art forest: dense green canopy, a glowing blue ancient tree, winding streams and dirt paths; flat Kenney-style sprites; airy flutes, birdsong and soft magical chimes

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how stones changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against giant beetles in Herbalist Hut.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 0.7).
